stem: How does the organization of the selection “Life on Mars” contribute to the author’s purpose?
instruction: Use “Life on Mars” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: By describing various findings, the author shows how research has affected scientists’ beliefs about Mars.

options.label: B
options.text: By offering contrasting theories, the author identifies the different kinds of life that may have existed on Mars.

options.label: C
options.text: By explaining a problem related to Mars, the author reveals why sending humans to Mars is necessary.

options.label: D
options.text: By listing the features found on Mars, the author shares what is needed to support life on Mars in order of importance.
